newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls to 574c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls to 574c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market continued to slide at sales in Newcastle and Melbourne on Thursday, with the eastern market indicator falling two cents to 574 cents a kg clean, Wool International (WI) said.

In merinos, 19/23 micron were one percent cheaper, while 20/22 microns were 0.5 percent cheaper and 21 micron was slightly cheaper. Merino skirtings 19/20/21/22 were generally unchanged, while 23 micron was two percent cheaper and 24 micron one percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27/30 microns were slightly dearer and 28 micron was 0.5 percent dearer.
The 29/31 microns were unchanged. In cardings, locks were slightly dearer and crutchings were generally unchanged.

Interest from Japan, China, Taiwan and Italy was supported by Western Europe. Of the 22,381 bales offered, 11 percent was passed in. Sales continue next week in Sydney and Geelong, with about 69,500 bales to be offered.
